headline: Union Pacific Beats Q3 Profit Estimates as Fuel Costs Weigh on Shares
summary: Union Pacific reported higher quarterly profits, beating earnings estimates by $0.06 per share on above-consensus revenue, though its stock dipped slightly due to fuel cost pressures.
why: Union Pacific is one of North America's largest railroad freight operators. Rail volumes and profitability reflect industrial output, agricultural shipments, and consumer goods distribution across the continent.

impacts.name: Union Pacific
impacts.why: Shares slipped slightly as fuel cost concerns counterbalanced an earnings and revenue beat.
